svg.title: Shoreline perforated training tee
svg.text: Perforated training tee. The Lake Bonneville terraces, laser-cut where you sweat.
Three dotted terraces: the Bonneville, Provo and Stansbury levels of the
ice-age lake, cut across the upper back where a vest or pack traps heat,
a shorter band on the chest, two on the underarm gussets. The laser seals
each hole as it cuts. From ten feet it is a texture; up close it is a map.
One line, left chest, 2.4 in wide, stacked condensed caps like a 1990 print
insert. A plain statement about the place: 4,219 ft is where the city sits, and
every run here starts by leaving it. The eyebrow under it names the terraces.
Nothing on the belly, nothing on the sleeves. Perforation only where sweat
maps say you need it, so the tee reads as engineered, not decorated.
1.2 MM HOLES, 3.5 MM PITCH AT THE TERRACE EDGE
Cut-and-sew raglan-free set-in tee, athletic fit, drop-tail hem +1 in. Made for VSL, not a stock blank.
100% recycled polyester micro-eyelet single jersey, 118 gsm, wicking finish, PFAS-free. Edges heat-seal under the laser.
CO2 laser perforation from vector file (back 11 x 7 in, chest 7 x 3 in, gussets 2 x 3 in). Water-based screen print, 1 color Cream, left
chest 2.4 x 1.3 in. 3M Scotchlite transfer, back neck 1.1 x 0.3 in.
Bonded hems (no stitch), flatlock side seams, self-fabric neck binding, printed care label, woven size tab with salt-crystal line icon at
Mountain Navy #13375D body · Cream #F6F1EC ink · reflective silver. Second run: Forest #0D4C26 / Sego Lily #FFDDA3.
